_comment: Test specification only. Case ids describe the audio's character, never who or when — the mapping back to real meetings lives in CASES.md inside the local eval store, which is never committed.

cases.notes: 1:1 huddle on loudspeakers, heavy speaker leak into the mic. The recording that exposed the Whisper priming truncation.

Raw channel captures — exercises the two-channel path incl. echo suppression. recall_min is 0.78 rather than the 0.85 used for the long pair case, and that is calibration, not a loosened bar: references are unfiltered Whisper, the pipeline correctly drops hallucinated segments, and this short stand-up has proportionally far more dead air for Whisper to hallucinate over. Measured 0.816-0.821 across four runs (long pair case, same metric, scores 0.97). Loss is even across both channels — a real regression shows up as one channel collapsing, which mic_unique_recall catches.
The recording whose entire mic channel was dropped by echo suppression in a live two-channel run.
Long raw channel pair salvaged from a failed pipeline run.
